title: Unit Event — Deeper and Deeper — Episode7 The Curtain Rises

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime agrees to participate in a workshop run by ArcLand. As Rui takes the directors' course, he is confronted with something he's never realized about himself before.

rows.Line: The day of the presentations
Center Theatre - Backstage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The day has finally arrived.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it has. Please allow me to take this opportunity to thank you all again for helping me with this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Especially since the actors' workshop was running in parallel. Practicing for both couldn't have been easy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, we knew that things would be hard going in...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She's right! Plus, we've been wanting to put the things we learned during this workshop into practice!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm so excited to have everyone see this show!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too. This will be the culmination of everything we learned during this workshop.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The audience consists only of the workshop's teachers and participants. They'll be giving us their harsh assessments once we're done.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But let's forget about all that for now.
We just need to do what we always do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Put on the best show we can for the audience that's right in front of us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I believe we're all eager to hear how this show is received, as well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It is pretty different from the ones we normally do.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wasn't sure we'd be able to pull it off, but I'm really excited to perform it now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe.
As the director, that makes me very happy to hear.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your script and directing plan are both very you, but there are twists, as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We know you struggled quite a lot with this...
But this is the answer you arrived upon.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It is.
I've put everything I can currently bring to bear into it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright. Let's go show them how our director, and Wonderlands×Showtime, break new ground.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're going to make this the best show ever.

rows.Speaker: Emu, Rui & Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: “Next, we have... Ah, Kamishiro.”

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: “Speaking of which, Tom, didn't you have a talk with him the other day?”

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line:
<“Yes, I just gave him a small piece of advice.
I believe that young man has quite a lot of potential.”>

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: “Oh? And that's not just lip service, is it?”

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line:
<“Of course not.
I think you'll understand soon enough.”>

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Alright, I guess it's okay for me to get my hopes up a little.
se_event_deeper_2025_002

rows.Speaker: Carriage Driver
rows.Line: “Eep...! H-Help me...!!”
“Hahaha! Crying for help already?”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“I know you can run faster than that.
You do not want to bore me!”

rows.Speaker: Carriage Driver
rows.Line:
“Wh-What...?!
Th-The monster's on top of the carriage...!”
se_event_deeper_2025_002
se_event_deeper_2025_003

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“Right down the embankment, huh?
That means I win our game of tag.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
How dull. Just when I thought you would help me pass the time...”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“I know!
I could masquerade as a human in the city.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “I may yet find something more interesting.”
se_event_deeper_2025_007
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Tavernkeeper
rows.Line:
“Alright, here's your ale.
Haven't seen you around here before, son. Are you a traveler?”

rows.Speaker: Young Traveler?
rows.Line: “Yes, more or less!”

rows.Speaker: Tavernkeeper
rows.Line:
“Then, be careful.
They say that there's a fearsome monster lurking in the woods nearby.”

rows.Speaker: Young Traveler?
rows.Line:
“Oh...?
What's so fearsome about it?”

rows.Speaker: Tavernkeeper
rows.Line: “It's a ruthless thing, and make no mistake. I've heard that it's smarter, stronger and faster than any human out there, and it's a cruel and selfish beast.”

rows.Speaker: Tavernkeeper
rows.Line: “Even today, I heard that it chased around a horse-drawn carriage just for fun. The poor driver was scared half to death.”

rows.Speaker: Young Traveler?
rows.Line:
“I see.
It sounds like it wanted someone to play with.”

rows.Speaker: Tavernkeeper
rows.Line:
“That's no excuse to chase people around!
Anyway, just be careful out there.”
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “As I suspected, humans just don't understand.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “What else could be more important in this world than having as much fun as possible?”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
I'm getting bored of this 'tavern' place already... Hm?”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “What is this...?”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “Oh, is this the first time you've ever heard a wandering minstrel sing?”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “A wandering minstrel...?”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “That's right! My friends and I travel around to various parts, singing about that region's local legends and history.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Hey, that sounds like fun...!”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “That song made me completely forget how bored I was.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Which means, if I can learn to sing like a minstrel, then...”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Hey! You must teach me how to sing!”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “What? Does that mean you wanna become my apprentice?!”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “My own apprentice...! I've always wanted one... No, if I'm going to be your master, then I have to act more dignified. Ahem!”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “Do you really want to become my apprentice?”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“Your apprentice...?
Yes, if it means learning how to sing like that.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Please, make me your apprentice!”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “Hmm... I can't really turn you away after seeing that look on your face...”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line:
“It's settled, then.
Starting today, you'll call me your master.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Yes, of course!”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “Hey, you're better than I was expecting.”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “But don't you know any less bizarre verses? These sound like something right out of a drunkard's nightmare.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Then, what words should I sing instead?”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “Well, something that resonates with everyone's hearts! For example...”

rows.Speaker: Local Human A
rows.Line: “Young man, you're that minstrel's apprentice, yes? Can you sing a song for me?”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “I refuse. I'm not learning how to sing for the likes of you.”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “Hey, how many times do I have to tell you not to talk to people like that?!”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “Also, it's a minstrel's job to sing and tell stories to people. If you can't accept that, then I won't teach you any more.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“Ah, that would be a problem...
Alright, just one song.”

rows.Speaker: Local Human A
rows.Line: “Oh, this is...”

rows.Speaker: Local Human B
rows.Line:
“Really good!
I could listen to him sing all day.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Oh, I guess some humans do have good taste...”

rows.Speaker: Local Human A
rows.Line:
“Thank you, young man!
I feel ready to do my best at work again tomorrow.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Sure! I might even be willing to sing for you again sometime.”

rows.Speaker: Local Human A
rows.Line: “Really? Then, I think I'll bring my wife along next time.”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “Hehe...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And so, the monster begins to blend in amongst the humans.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This all began with his simple quest to seek “fun”, but...)

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “You have a way of making everybody around you smile.”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “Every now and then, you do something way off-beat... But I know it's all in good fun.”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “I couldn't have asked for a better apprentice.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The monster's nature hasn't actually changed. He's a simple creature who only wishes to have fun.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Something begins to blossom within his heart.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He hasn't realized it yet, but a compulsion to express these feelings is slowly growing...)

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Thank you...”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Director A
rows.Line: That was good.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Director B
rows.Line: Yes, it was a subdued performance, but the lights and the way he used the stage made it an impactful scene.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (In big theatres, you have to really exaggerate your movements to make sure everyone in the audience can see what you're doing.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But Tsukasa and Rui came up with the best way to use this stage after some really long practices and discussions.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Things have gone well so far, but the hard part is coming up...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (One day, a lone hunter arrives in the city where the monster lives, and everything changes...)
se_walk_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line:
“You must all listen to me.
There is a horrible monster living among you in this very city.”

rows.Speaker: Local Humans
rows.Line: “I-In this city...?”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “It's transformed into a human and is currently masquerading around as one of you. However, its true nature is fundamentally inhuman.”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “This creature is selfish, pleasure-seeking, and thoughtlessly cruel. That's what makes it a monster.”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “Before it inevitably harms someone... I must expose it, and put it down.”

rows.Speaker: Local Humans
rows.Line: “That's terrifying...”

rows.Speaker: Local Humans
rows.Line: “Yeah, and it's pretending to be human like us? How creepy.”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “I don't like this mood in the square...”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Me neither...”
